title: CHARLEVILLE,QLD-4470 - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: Services in Charleville (QLD 4470) experienced an unplanned access network outage caused by a local power issue. All affected services were restored at 2:31 PM AEST on 29 July 2026. If any services remain offline, restarting the modem/router and connection box may help. We are monitoring for stability.

updates.content: Resolved: Some customers in Charleville (QLD 4470) experienced a loss of service due to a local power issue in the access network. Services were restored at 2:31 PM AEST on 29 July. If your connection hasn’t come back online, please restart your modem/router and connection box (if present). We’re monitoring the area and appreciate your patience.
